sources.title: Discover Greece: Top 12 things to do in Santorini
sources.summary: Greek tourism-sector platform recommends April–May and mid-September–October; describes Oia architecture and island planning. It does not provide measured hourly crowd counts.

sources.title: Time and Date: Santorini sunrise, sunset and twilight
sources.summary: Date/month/year sun tables use local Santorini time and provide twilight and sunset direction. Used as a planning calculator, not a weather or access forecast.

sources.title: Time and Date: The Blue Hour
sources.summary: Explains blue hour during twilight and variation with latitude and season; does not promise a fixed half-hour window.

sources.title: KTEL Santorini: Current route information
sources.summary: Official new route page identifies Fira–Oia with departure/return columns. Page labels/update dates and legacy cached pages require date-specific reconfirmation; no timetable or fare quoted.

sources.title: Kastro Oia: Contact and sunset reservations
sources.summary: Venue-owned page lists seasonal sunset reservation times and asks diners not to block other tables. Article cites the policy pattern, not a fixed future-year seating or operating-hours guarantee.

sources.title: Oia Gefsis: Restaurant and reservation FAQ
sources.summary: Venue-owned site promotes a west-facing sunset terrace, recommends reservations and describes sunset as busy. Seating availability and terms must be confirmed directly; no review, award or price claims adopted.

claims.claim: April–May and mid-September–October are recommended shoulder-season periods by the Greek tourism-sector source; not a guarantee of no crowds.
Santorini sunset/twilight calculations are date-specific local times, with horizon direction data.
Blue hour occurs during twilight and its duration depends on latitude and season.
KTEL official routes identify the Fira–Oia connection and departure/return information.
Kastro publishes season-dependent sunset seating information and table-view etiquette.
Oia Gefsis advertises sunset terrace views, recommends sunset reservations and describes sunset demand.

verificationFlags: Reconfirm KTEL date-specific outward and return schedules; old English timetable URLs return errors and the current page has inconsistent seasonal/update labels. No precise bus times, cash-only rules or fares are asserted.
Recheck restaurant operating dates, exact table views, seasonal seating times and booking/cancellation terms before publication; examples are not personal reviews or endorsements.
Morning before 9am, S-minus-two-hours arrival and S-plus-45–60-minute dinner are editorial planning allowances, not measured crowd cutoffs, guaranteed access or operator schedules.
Check sunset for the actual travel date and location; the 8pm example is explicitly hypothetical, not a quoted astronomical event. Weather, sightline and access may change.
Approve or replace contextual Santorini archive imagery: its exact location is not verified as Oia and this is disclosed in the draft.
Check current viewpoint access, private-property boundaries and any local restrictions; no specific viewpoint is promised open or accessible.
Owner must approve article and set the actual release date before publication.
overlapReview: Read the existing Fira 3–7-day itinerary, including its brief recommendation to spend an evening in Oia. This draft covers the distinct Oia visit-planning intent in detail: crowd-aware seasons/morning timing, date-relative photography schedule, transport/return decisions and dinner booking. It links to the Fira itinerary instead of replacing its island-wide day plan. Existing proposed Santorini transport/season/stay topics remain broad island-level plans; this article is scoped to one Oia outing.
limitations: No firsthand visit, restaurant meal, operator endorsement, affiliate partnership, measured crowd count or guaranteed sunset is claimed.
Only primary tourism-sector, transport-operator, venue-owned and astronomical publisher sources are cited; no paid research or inference API used.
Failed legacy KTEL and alternate calculator/venue URLs were not treated as successful sources. Current accessible canonical pages are used.
No exact monthly future-year sunset table is fabricated. Photographer-oriented timing is clearly separated from astronomical sunset data.
